conclusions: Authenticated checkpoint membership can bind a seed value; this does not prove entropy, unpredictability, unbiased generation or non-withholding.

Observed coordinator gatherer locally samples rand::thread_rng; transition circuit uses an unconstrained virtual contribution as the new seed, later included in the authenticated leaf. No VRF/threshold entropy verification was found in that observed path.
This is evidence for the inspected local source path, not attestation that the remote services run it.
Actual pre-revelation order-set inclusion, fixed future target, anti-redraw and selective-abort rules remain release blockers for random mode.
